channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Requião Filho fala em reverter privatizações no PR e justifica apoio a Lula
item.description: Requião Filho, PDT candidate for Governor of Paraná, criticized the privatizations carried out by Governor Ratinho Jr (PSD) and pledged to reverse them if elected. During a UOL/Folha sabatina, he also justified his support for President Lula's re-election, despite having criticized him last year, and called Flávio Bolsonaro 'abject'.

item.title: PSB-MA expulsa prefeito que exigiu voto de servidores em Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The mayor of Campestre do Maranhão, Fernando Oliveira da Silva (known as Fernando Bermuda), was expelled from the PSB after sending messages to public employees demanding they vote for Flávio Bolsonaro for president, threatening dismissal for non-compliance. The party deemed the action a violation of democratic and ethical principles.

item.title: Flávio diz que falta de aval não torna vídeo de Bolsonaro deepfake
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign told the TSE that AI-generated political content is not a deepfake merely due to lack of consent, arguing that deceptive intent or electoral harm must be present. They cited a legal opinion by Professor Diogo Rais, stating that AI tools expand but do not eliminate legitimate political expression, and that satire or parody without serious disinformation should not be deemed illicit. The video in question shows Flávio declaring Jair Bolsonaro a 'victim of the biggest fraud the country has ever witnessed,' aired at the PL convention.

item.title: Candidato à Câmara, empresário de Belo diz não ter patrimônio
item.description: Alfredo Santana, a federal deputy candidate for Rio de Janeiro from the Republicans party and businessman for singer Belo, declared to the Electoral Justice that he has no assets to disclose. The information is listed on the official TSE platform. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: A explicação de Flávio sobre o uso de Bolsonaro de IA em vídeo na convenção do PL
item.description: The defense of Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party’s presidential candidate, argued before the TSE that banning AI use in political campaigns is infeasible and unconstitutional, stating that deepfakes and similar tools are not illegal absent intent to deceive voters. The legal team emphasized that lack of consent from the portrayed individual does not determine illegality, provided there is no deceptive intent, and that satire, parody, and digital avatars are legitimate parts of political communication. The stance comes ahead of a TSE meeting to review a PT action against an AI-generated video of Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Moraes virou articulador político de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate, accused Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of being the "political articulator" of Lula's campaign, referencing a dinner between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre at Moraes's residence. He claimed Moraes had entered the political arena, making himself a legitimate target for political rebuttals. During a meeting with Senate candidates he supports, Flávio asked if they would vote for Moraes's impeachment, and all answered in the affirmative.

item.title: Planalto cobra assessor sobre relação com Roberta Luchsinger após desgaste com caso Marcola
item.description: Presidential aide Berger was questioned by the Planalto over alleged ties to Roberta Luchsinger, a businesswoman under investigation for influence-peddling linked to Lula’s son, following meetings at the Health Ministry and communications with Careca do INSS. Berger denied granting any improper advantage, stating her request for a medicinal cannabis contract did not proceed. The government said it would have considered removing him had he admitted involvement.

item.title: Governo Lula quer destravar 6 MPs e votar PL da Misoginia nesta semana
item.description: The Lula government set priorities for the week in Congress during a meeting at the Planalto Palace: unblock six provisional measures and vote on the Misogyny Bill (PL 896/2023). The strategy includes installing special committees this Wednesday (12/8) to enable voting on the measures by September, led by government ministers and congressional leaders.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: 20% dos eleitores definem voto para presidente na última semana
item.description: Genial/Quaest poll shows 20% of Brazilian voters decide their presidential vote only in the final week of the campaign, with 10% deciding on Election Day. Early decision-making is stronger among Lula and Bolsonaro supporters (69% each), while independents and regions like Center-West/North exhibit higher rates of late decisions, particularly in state-level races.

item.title: Quartas da Copa do Brasil 2026: veja os confrontos e o chaveamento até a final
item.description: The quarterfinals of the 2026 Copa do Brasil feature three state derbies: Internacional vs Grêmio, Cruzeiro vs Atlético-MG, and Palmeiras vs Santos, plus Vasco vs Vitória. The bracket sets up a semifinal where the winner of the Gre-Nal faces the winner of the Minas Gerais derby, while the Vasco-Vitória winner plays the Palmeiras-Santos winner. The final will be a single match on December 6, with the champion receiving R$ 78 million in prize money.

item.title: Flávio descarta troca de vice e confirma Alfredo Gaspar na chapa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed that Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) will remain as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 election, ruling out any changes at this time. The statement aims to quell speculation about alterations to the ticket, emphasizing the stability of the PL alliance. Flávio also noted that the campaign's strength lies in the party structure built across states.

item.title: Durigan molda plano econômico de Lula sem garantia de ficar na Fazenda
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is leading the design of Lula’s potential fourth-term economic plan, proposing fiscal tightening through reduced spending growth caps (from 2.5% to 1.5%), new expenditure triggers, and tax benefit cuts. He pledged a 0.5% of GDP primary surplus by 2027 and debt stabilization by 2030, but has received no assurance from Lula about retaining his post if re-elected. His possible departure by end-2024 would mark the shortest tenure at the Finance Ministry since Eduardo Guardia in 2018.

item.title: Mulheres vereadoras têm mais chance de abandonar a política ou de nunca se reeleger, diz estudo
item.description: A study published in the Brazilian Political Science Review finds that women elected as city councilors in Brazil are more likely to leave politics or fail to be re-elected compared to men. The research identifies structural and gender-based barriers as key factors contributing to the lower continuity of women in political office.

item.title: CNT/MDA: 36% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo e 35% como ótimo ou bom
item.description: The CNT/MDA poll shows 36.2% of voters rate Lula's government as bad or terrible, compared to 35.3% who rate it as good or excellent, with disapproval up 2 points since June. Personal approval of Lula stands at 47%, technically tied with 48% disapproval. Negative ratings are highest among men, those aged 35-44, earners above 5 minimum wages, and those with higher education, while the Northeast remains Lula's strongest base with 49% positive evaluation.

item.title: TRE libera slogan "Meu voto é casado" para Zanatta e marido em SC
item.description: The TRE-SC authorized the use of the slogan 'My vote is married' by Júlia Zanatta and her husband Guilherme Colombo during the pre-campaign, rejecting the PSOL's claim of premature electoral propaganda. The court ruled that the expression, without an explicit vote request or electoral number, does not constitute an irregularity at this stage. Zanatta is seeking re-election to the Chamber of Deputies and Colombo is running for a seat in the Santa Catarina Legislative Assembly, both from the PL party.

item.title: Quem é o cinegrafista demitido da Globo após dar cabeçada em repórter
item.description: Gustavo Clemente, a Globo News cameraman, was fired after headbutting photographer Igor Carvalho of Brasil de Fato during coverage of the Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas debate on Band on August 9. Clemente claimed he reacted to verbal and physical provocations from the photographer, though he later expressed regret and acknowledged the incident should not have escalated.

item.title: Flávio diz ao TSE que IA não pode ser ‘completamente eliminada’ das eleições após vídeo de Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's lawyers told the TSE that artificial intelligence cannot be completely eliminated from elections, arguing its use in political campaigns is legitimate and not inherently fraudulent. The statement was made in response to a PT action against an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the convention that confirmed Flávio as the PL's presidential candidate. The defense requested the dismissal of the action, asserting the video does not constitute an electoral irregularity.

item.title: CNT/MDA: 36,2% veem governo Lula como negativo e 35,3% acham positivo
item.description: The CNT/MDA poll shows 36.2% of respondents view Lula's government negatively in August 2026, surpassing the 35.3% who view it positively, with disapproval rising from 34.4% in June. Personal approval stands at 47.3% and disapproval at 48.2%, a statistical tie within the margin of error. This marks Lula's worst August performance since 2006, when negative ratings were only 15.6%.

item.title: Biometria nas eleições: entenda como funciona a identificação biométrica
item.description: Biometric identification in elections uses fingerprints to verify voter identity, enhancing security and preventing fraud while preserving vote secrecy. The system is integrated with electronic voting machines and has been widely used in Brazil since 2008.

item.title: Flávio diz que irá a debates se Lula for: "Vou aonde ele estiver"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will only participate in presidential debates if President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is present, emphasizing his focus on debating Lula directly. The comment was made during a press briefing at his campaign headquarters in Brasília's Lago Sul neighborhood on August 11. Flávio denied any changes to his ticket and dismissed accusations against him as a 'farce'.

item.title: Planalto procura Motta após presidente da Câmara declarar apoio a Lula
item.description: The Planalto Palace reached out to Chamber President Hugo Motta after he declared support for Lula's re-election in 2026. The contact was made by Minister of Institutional Relations José Guimarães, who thanked the gesture and said Lula was pleased. Motta aims to strengthen his father Nabor Wanderley’s Senate bid in 2026 and secure Planalto backing for his own re-election as Chamber president in 2027.

item.title: Crusoé: Milei usa insultos como arma política
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared a post by a U.S. Republican congressman calling Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'pig'. Milei used the insult as a political weapon against Lula, highlighting diplomatic tensions between Argentina and Brazil. The post followed comments by Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira in an interview.

item.title: R$ 178 milhões: Zema explica aumento de 38% em seu patrimônio
item.description: Romeu Zema, the presidential candidate from the NOVO Party, explained that his 38% increase in net worth between 2022 and 2026 — from R$129.7 million to R$178.7 million — stems from shares in family-held companies and financial investments. He emphasized his background as a successful entrepreneur who opened over 470 stores in small municipalities and affirmed his consistent transparency regarding personal and professional finances.

item.title: O futuro sinuoso visto pelo JPMorgan para o mercado acionário brasileiro
item.description: JPMorgan downgraded its recommendation for Brazilian stocks from buy to neutral, citing the end of the interest rate cutting cycle and the approaching elections as factors that should increase volatility in the local equity market. The bank expects a 0.25 percentage point cut in the Selic rate in September, followed by a prolonged pause until Q2 2027, alongside slowing economic growth and deteriorating credit conditions. Although Brazilian equities have historically underperformed in the six months before elections, this pattern did not occur in 2026, which JPMorgan says raises the likelihood of future volatility.

item.title: PEC da Segurança é prioridade do governo no Senado para criar novo ministério antes de eleição
item.description: The Lula government is prioritizing the Senate vote on the Public Security PEC to establish a new Ministry of Public Security before the 2026 elections, aiming to strengthen its image in combating organized crime. The proposal is considered more feasible than the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale and is currently being negotiated with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre following their earlier rift over the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. The government also seeks to advance other initiatives, including regulating rare earths, using oil surplus to control fuel prices, and criminalizing misogyny, with a strategic focus on electoral gains, particularly among women voters.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro defende ao TSE que uso de IA não depende de autorização da pessoa retratada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense argued before the TSE that the use of AI in electoral campaigns does not require authorization from the person depicted, stating that lack of consent is 'absolutely indifferent' in characterizing a deepfake. The lawyers asserted that the decisive factor is whether the content is false or misleading, not the subject's permission, and that requiring prior consent would practically eliminate the tool's use in political campaigns. The submission comes amid TSE deliberations over an AI-generated video simulating Jair Bolsonaro's support for his son, displayed at the PL convention, as the court seeks to determine whether such uses automatically constitute irregularities or only when intended to deceive voters or harm the electoral process.

item.title: Em meio ao tarifaço dos EUA, ministro se reúne com chefe de bloco asiático para ampliar comércio
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met with the Philippines' Secretary of Foreign Affairs, Maria Theresa Lazaro, in Brasília to strengthen commercial ties with ASEAN amid U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. The meeting followed a session with President Lula at the Alvorada Palace and continued at Itamaraty, highlighting Brazil's strategy to diversify its trade partners. In 2025, Brazil-ASEAN trade exceeded US$38.4 billion, with the Philippines becoming Brazil's top destination for pork exports, reaching approximately US$840 million.

item.title: Lula terá menor número de candidatos do PT a governador desde 94 e aposta em ‘rachar’ apoio a Flávio
item.description: The PT will field its lowest number of gubernatorial candidates since 1994, with only 12 own candidacies in 2026, reducing its statewide presence to prioritize alliances with Centrão parties like PSD and União Brasil. The strategy aims to bolster Lula’s support in regional strongholds while undermining Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) candidacy by siphoning off his base. The Minas Gerais deal, naming Patrus Ananias as candidate, completed the coalition map, which includes Bahia, Ceará, São Paulo, and the Federal District, with concessions in other states to back allied candidates.

item.title: Ônibus perdem passageiros enquanto Tarifa Zero chega a 143 cidades do país
item.description: Public bus transport lost passengers in Brazil in 2025, with total trips down 3.7% and paying passenger trips down 5.8%, leaving demand at 77.5% of pre-pandemic levels. Meanwhile, the number of municipalities offering free public transport (Tarifa Zero) rose to 143, though growth slowed and remains concentrated in smaller cities.

item.title: Candidato à Presidência pelo PCO é alvo de buscas da PF por suspeita de desvio do fundo partidário
item.description: The Federal Police conducted search and seizure operations in Brasília targeting suspects of misappropriating funds from the Party Fund and the Special Campaign Financing Fund (FEFC), including presidential candidate Rui Costa Pimenta of the PCO. Operation Causa Própria investigates indications that public funds meant for political-party activities were diverted to entities lacking operational capacity or linked to the investigated party structure. Judicial measures include bank account freezes and asset sequestration ordered by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Dino afirma que não há ‘crise terminal’ no Judiciário, mas defende reforma para punir ‘corruptos’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino rejected the notion of a 'terminal crisis' in the Judiciary but advocated for reforms to punish corrupt actors, combat money laundering through legal funds, and prevent the buying and selling of rulings. He attributed the crisis narrative to ideological motives, political-electoral opportunism, and financial interests, emphasizing that priority areas include procedural delays, misuse of AI, and fake precatory payments.

item.title: Lula tem 48% e Flávio soma 39,1% no 2º turno, mostra CNT/MDA
item.description: A CNT/MDA poll released on Tuesday shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading the potential runoff with 48% of voting intentions, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) trails at 39,1%. Lula holds an 8.9-point advantage, indicating a stable lead in the presidential race.

item.title: CNT/MDA: Lula lidera corrida presidencial contra Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, por 48% a 39%
item.description: According to the CNT/MDA poll released on March 11, 2025, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race in a potential second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, with 48% of voting intentions compared to Bolsonaro’s 39.1%. Lula holds an 8.9-point advantage, underscoring his strong position against a candidate aligned with the Bolsonaro political family.

item.title: Direção do Festival de Brasília fala em 'página virada' e confirma realização do evento após reviravolta em repasse de verbas
item.description: The Brasília Film Festival, Brazil's oldest active film festival, was initially canceled due to a R$ 3 million funding delay from the DF's Culture Secretariat but was later confirmed by Governor Celina Leão after public backlash. The 59th edition will take place from September 11 to 19 at Cine Brasília, with funds secured and pre-production completed. Festival officials described the cancellation as a 'turned page' and affirmed the event will proceed as planned.

item.title: Flávio descarta troca de vice e diz ter ‘confiança’ em Alfredo Gaspar: ‘Pessoa preparada e de coragem’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro ruled out replacing Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 election, expressing continued confidence in the deputy despite allegations of rape of a vulnerable minor and embezzlement of parliamentary amendments. He attributed the scrutiny to Gaspar’s role in investigating pension fraud via the INSS CPI, calling him 'prepared', 'courageous', and 'a good person'. Gaspar denies the allegations and has requested a DNA test to prove his innocence, while the case remains under seal at the STF under Justice Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: Tarcísio anuncia na Fiesp nova prorrogação de benefícios fiscais do ICMS
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced at Fiesp the extension of ICMS tax benefits set to expire on December 31, 2026, without specifying when the measure will be published or which industrial segments will be included. The policy aims to maintain competitiveness for São Paulo’s industry and agribusiness, ensuring legal security and predictability to stimulate investment and protect jobs during the transition to a new tax system. This contrasts with his earlier stance of cutting a third of expiring subsidies, though he had already extended similar benefits in December of last year.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nega que trocará Gaspar como vice e diz que acusações contra deputado são ‘farsa’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied that he will replace Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential running mate, calling the rape allegations against the deputy a 'farce' that emerged when Gaspar was defending retirees against alleged PT government misappropriations. He reiterated that the PL has endorsed 47 Senate candidates nationwide, granting each state the freedom to adapt campaign messaging to local realities while maintaining a general strategic line.

item.title: Após vídeo de Bolsonaro, Flávio diz ao TSE que uso de IA em campanha não exige autorização prévia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense told the TSE that the use of artificial intelligence in political campaigns cannot be banned or require prior authorization, arguing that tools like deepfakes are legitimate extensions of political communication and that regulation should focus on intent to deceive, not the technology itself. The submission came ahead of a TSE meeting to discuss ruling on a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro aired at the convention that formalized Flávio as the PL's presidential candidate.

item.title: Após crise, Flávio confirma gravação com Michelle para programa eleitoral e elogia ex-primeira-dama: ‘Pessoa qualificada’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed that Michelle Bolsonaro will participate in the filming of his electoral program, marking their first in-person meeting since the rift during the presidential ticket formation. He praised her as a 'qualified person', specifically highlighting her work with the deaf community during Jair Bolsonaro’s administration. The collaboration aims to bolster Flávio’s presidential campaign and Michelle’s Senate bid in the DF, with allies also seeking to leverage her electoral capital in their own campaigns.

item.title: Os ataques ‘sem precedentes’ ao Brasil, segundo Mauro Vieira
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira described the attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei and U.S. President Donald Trump on Brazil as 'unprecedented,' citing Milei's insults toward President Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, as well as U.S. tariffs. He characterized these behaviors as gross, affronts to Brazilian sovereignty and democracy, and said they must be repelled, referencing the 'Hour of the Predators' concept from Giuliano da Empoli's book.

item.title: Renan Santos: por que parte da Faria Lima embarcou no discurso radical do candidato estreante em eleições
item.description: A segment of São Paulo’s financial elite, Faria Lima, has embraced the radical discourse of presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão), viewing him as a disruptive alternative to the political establishment. This support emerged despite Eduardo Bolsonaro’s cassation and his June live-stream questioning of Santos’ electoral potential. The backing reflects a desire for systemic change among economically influential groups dissatisfied with current polarization.

item.title: TSE deve acelerar definição sobre IA e pesquisas para evitar contaminar campanhas
item.description: The TSE aims to establish rules in the coming weeks regarding the use of AI-generated avatars and permissible tools in electoral polls, to prevent these issues from influencing the 2026 campaigns. The discussion includes regulating or banning deepfakes, such as the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro used at the PL convention, and potentially allowing videos and audio in research questionnaires if registered with the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aposta em ‘tesouraço’ e âncora fiscal baseada em dívida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has centered his 2026 election campaign on tax cuts, deregulation, legal security, and private investment incentives, without presenting a structured government plan. Fiscally, he proposes replacing the current LRF rule with a debt-to-GDP-based framework featuring automatic spending cuts triggered when a yet-undefined threshold is exceeded. His economic coordinator, Daniella Marques, advocates a PEC to make this rule more restrictive, but questions remain about how to reconcile tax cuts with debt reduction and the intended flexibility of the Fiscal Responsibility Law.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Fachin quer moralizar o STF e a briga de aloprados nas eleições
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discusses accusations against federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) linked to vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), and the new effort by STF President Minister Luís Roberto Barroso to moralize the Judiciary, highlighting political and judicial tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘PSOL não é bem-vindo’, diz Kalil sobre adesão de federação de esquerda à sua campanha em Minas
item.description: Alexandre Kalil (PDT), Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, rejected PSOL’s inclusion in his ticket, stating only Rede Sustentabilidade is welcome, despite the PSOL-Rede federation voting to support him internally. The move creates tension with the national PSOL leadership, which seeks to overturn the decision and realign with the PT, while Kalil views the federation as a threat to his political independence. The development also affects the Senate race, where PSOL’s Áurea Carolina faces PT’s Marília Campos, as the PT prioritizes a centrist PSB candidate for the second Senate seat.

item.title: Com bullying de 5ª série, Milei vira cabo eleitoral de Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei faced backlash for making offensive remarks about Brazil and its president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, triggering a negative reaction among the Brazilian public. Despite his attempt to position himself as an ideological ally of Lula, his conduct was perceived as arrogant and disrespectful, indirectly strengthening Lula’s image as a defender of national sovereignty. The episode shows how external criticism, even from ideologically aligned figures, can be rejected when perceived as overbearing.

item.title: Metade dos brasileiros defende proibição de propaganda eleitoral feita com IA, aponta CNT/MDA
item.description: Half of Brazilians support banning AI-generated political videos and ads in the 2026 elections, according to a CNT/MDA poll released on Tuesday, the 11th. The findings reflect growing concerns about disinformation and electoral manipulation through advanced technologies.

item.title: Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro gravam propaganda eleitoral nesta terça
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL-DF) are recording the first electoral advertisement video for the 2026 elections this Tuesday (11/8). This marks their first in-person meeting since a campaign crisis, when Michelle claimed she was disrespected by her stepson. Flávio also has a busy schedule meeting with Senate candidates, while Michelle is not expected to attend those gatherings.

item.title: 'Se pensar fosse crime, a maioria das pessoas teria de ser detida', diz Zema sobre condenados por atos golpistas de 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo party, criticized the convictions of those involved in the January 8th riots, arguing that thinking about or planning a crime should not be equated with committing it. He described the events as 'hooliganism' and vandalism, denying they constituted an attempted coup, and maintained that only executed actions should be severely punished.

item.title: TSE decide nesta quinta data de julgamento sobre IA de Bolsonaro e deepfake eleitoral
item.description: The TSE scheduled a Thursday meeting to set the date for a collegial ruling on an AI-generated deepfake video of former President Jair Bolsonaro expressing support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision aims to establish a precedent for the 2026 elections by applying the TSE resolution banning synthetic content that favors or harms candidates. Ministers are divided on interpreting the rule in the context of AI use in political communication.
